title: Multimodal Evaluation of Russian-language Architectures
findings: The benchmark includes a component (the 'Open Category' in the ruHHH-Image dataset) to assess prejudice towards groups based on religion. However, the paper reports only aggregated scores for this dataset and does not provide specific findings or a breakdown of model performance related to religion.
